red: Red represents more than the color of the McPherson College Bulldogs. It represents the pride, tradition, and community behind the college we call home. As a team built on McPherson's automotive heritage, we carry that identity into a new era of engineering and motorsport. Every student, every accomplishment, and every step forward reflects the institution that made this opportunity possible.
riot: Riot represents our determination to challenge expectations and bring a fresh perspective to Formula SAE. Unlike programs centered solely around engineering, Red Riot Racing brings together students from all majors, combining the strengths of automotive restoration, engineering, graphic design, business, marketing, and beyond. We believe our greatest advantage comes from approaching challenges differently, encouraging students with unique backgrounds and perspectives to contribute toward a common goal. Our riot isn't about disorder; it's about challenging convention and proving that innovation thrives when different ideas come together.
racing: Racing represents the ultimate goal that unites everything we do. Our ambition is to design, manufacture, and compete with a Formula SAE race car, taking McPherson College onto the same competitive stage as some of the largest and most established university programs in the nation. As a smaller institution entering a highly competitive environment, we recognize the challenges ahead. But through determination, technical development, and the support of our partners, we intend to demonstrate that success isn't defined by the size of a college, but by the dedication and capabilities of the people representing it.
